hook_text: Half a cup of sugar plus a quarter cup. Is that 2/6 of a cup? That would be less than you started with!
clip_script: Baking koeksisters in Paarl. Half a cup of sugar, plus a quarter cup. Add tops and bottoms? 2/6. That is less than half! Impossible. The pieces are different sizes. Match them first: 1/2 is 2/4. Now 2/4 plus 1/4 is 3/4 of a cup. Running club in Gqeberha: 2 and 1/4 km plus 1 and 3/8 km. Wholes: 3. Parts: 2/8 plus 3/8 is 5/8. Total: 3 and 5/8 km. Not enough parts to subtract? Break a whole. Match the pieces first!
visual_style: Measuring cups filling with sugar, fraction bars cutting halves into quarters, then a running track with distance markers.
mood: Homely and warm, with a flash of surprise at the wrong answer.
pacing: A trap, a pause, the fix, then a quick running-club sum.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find how far Lerato still has to run.
